detail.longDescription: Well, the cluster might finally be usable - in barest form. CNI and CoreDNS. It seems extremely brittle though, things just...go wrong and the fix is to reboot the nodes or restart pods. This is hilariously (in a laugh-or-you'll-cry way) not the stability I've experienced from managed or proprietary distros of Kubernetes. # Kubernetes # Homelab # k8s # K8sathome
